title: Morning House Report smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Morning House Report craftbook: the whole fake house is polled through the wired device tools, the garage door left open overnight and the low sensor battery surface first with suggested actions, and the nominal rest is compressed to a glanceable line or two.
prompt: morning - whats the house looking like today? give me the unusal stuff first

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for morning-report. The fake house's device tools are wired into the project's tool roster — the device inventory and the live state snapshot come from them, and they are the only source of truth for what the house is doing this morning. The polling evidence goes to notes/states.md and the morning report to report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Morning House Report craftbook/template, read every zone's state through the wired device tools, surface anything unusual first with one suggested action each, compress the nominal rest, and write report.md. No real smart-home services, hubs, or credentials — only the wired fake house.

mocks.description: Fake smart-home MCP for this eval. Its tools surface directly on the tool roster: list the house's device inventory and read the current state snapshot of every device, battery levels included.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List every device in the house with its id, name, zone, and type

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read the current state snapshot of every device in the house, with battery levels and last-change times where the device reports them

success.summary: report.md leads with the garage door open since 23:41 and the backyard sensor at 9 percent battery — each with a suggested action — before any all-clear, the evidence in notes/states.md carries the real device ids from the tools (inventory and state snapshot actually read — request-log assertions), and the nominal rest is compressed rather than dumped.

checks.label: the state evidence carries real device ids from the tools
the garage door left open overnight is surfaced
the low sensor battery is surfaced

checks.rubric: The two anomalies (the garage door open overnight and the backyard sensor's low battery) appear before anything normal and each carries one concrete suggested action, every device mentioned matches the recorded state evidence, the nominal rest of the house is compressed to a line or two rather than a device-by-device dump, and the whole report reads comfortably in under a minute.
checks.label: anomalies-first and glanceable

axes.name: anomaly-detection
axes.description: The open garage door and the low battery are both caught from the state snapshot; nothing unusual is missed or invented.

axes.name: prioritization
axes.description: Anomalies lead, most urgent first, each with one concrete suggested action; the all-clear never buries them.

axes.name: brevity
axes.description: The nominal rest is compressed by zone to a line or two — glanceable before coffee, no inventory dump.

axes.name: warmth
axes.description: It reads like the house saying good morning — plain, friendly words, no telemetry jargon.
